field_dispel_01.note: Intentionally empty. Intended recording: a short magical field-collapse fizzle with a restrained tail, communicating successful removal. Cue gain remains provisional until a recording is supplied and auditioned.

electrical_injury_01.note: Intentionally empty. Intended recording: a brief electrical injury impact for resolved dungeon field damage, distinct from sustained field ambience. Cue gain remains provisional until a recording is supplied and auditioned.

sfx/SoundCannonFire.name: Cannon Fire
sfx/SoundCannonFire.howToHear: Fire a cannon with a valid direction and ammunition.

sfx/SoundBroadside.name: Broadside
sfx/SoundBroadside.howToHear: A heavy impact cue plays when a pirate broadside hits the party's vessel.

sfx/SoundGlassBreak.name: Glass Break
sfx/SoundGlassBreak.howToHear: Attack an intact mirror in a town or building; the successful break requests this cue.

sfx/SoundEarthquake.name: Earthquake
sfx/SoundEarthquake.howToHear: Trigger an earthquake effect; inspect each workflow using this shared cue.

sfx/SoundSummon.name: Summon
sfx/SoundSummon.howToHear: A magical activation cue accompanies committed carpet boarding or an HMS Cape activation change.

sfx/SoundAbsorb.name: Absorb
sfx/SoundAbsorb.howToHear: Magical absorption feedback plays when a casting attempt is absorbed instead of taking effect.

sfx/SoundPushObject.name: Push Object
sfx/SoundPushObject.howToHear: Object-movement feedback is requested after a successful push or pull into a free tile.

sfx/SoundOpenDoor.name: Open Door
sfx/SoundOpenDoor.howToHear: Door-opening audio plays after successfully opening an unlocked door or a supported chest.

sfx/SoundUnlock.name: Unlock
sfx/SoundUnlock.howToHear: Unlock feedback is requested when a supported lock, chest trap, or hidden-door mechanism is successfully released.

sfx/SoundTrapTrigger.name: Trap Trigger
sfx/SoundTrapTrigger.howToHear: Trigger a trapped object; exact trap type and caller need verification.

sfx/SoundStepOnTrap.name: Step On Trap
sfx/SoundStepOnTrap.howToHear: Step onto a triggering trap tile; verify that this cue, rather than falling feedback, is requested.

sfx/SoundFireBurn.name: Fire Burn
sfx/SoundFireBurn.howToHear: Take environmental damage from lava or a fireplace: a one-second cue fades over its last 200ms. Repeated damage retriggers one voice. Move beyond nearby fire to distinguish the separately owned ambience.

sfx/SoundHeal.name: Heal
sfx/SoundHeal.howToHear: Successfully heal an injured character using Mani, a healing potion, or a healing service.

sfx/SoundMoongateTravel.name: Moongate Travel
sfx/SoundMoongateTravel.howToHear: Travel through an active moongate; distinguish travel feedback from nearby gate hum.

sfx/SoundWalkGrassLeft.name: Walk Grass Left
sfx/SoundWalkGrassLeft.howToHear: Walk on grass/default terrain on foot; alternating successful steps select left and right variants.

sfx/SoundWalkGrassRight.name: Walk Grass Right
sfx/SoundWalkGrassRight.howToHear: Walk on grass/default terrain on foot; alternating successful steps select left and right variants.

sfx/SoundWalkStone1.name: Walk Stone 1
sfx/SoundWalkStone1.howToHear: Walk repeatedly across brick flooring on foot; four variants cycle with the shared step counter.

sfx/SoundWalkStone2.name: Walk Stone 2
sfx/SoundWalkStone2.howToHear: Walk repeatedly across brick flooring on foot; four variants cycle with the shared step counter.

sfx/SoundWalkStone3.name: Walk Stone 3
sfx/SoundWalkStone3.howToHear: Walk repeatedly across brick flooring on foot; four variants cycle with the shared step counter.

sfx/SoundWalkStone4.name: Walk Stone 4
sfx/SoundWalkStone4.howToHear: Walk repeatedly across brick flooring on foot; four variants cycle with the shared step counter.

sfx/SoundWalkWood1.name: Walk Wood 1
sfx/SoundWalkWood1.howToHear: Walk repeatedly across wooden flooring or supported wooden ship tiles; three variants cycle.

sfx/SoundWalkWood2.name: Walk Wood 2
sfx/SoundWalkWood2.howToHear: Walk repeatedly across wooden flooring or supported wooden ship tiles; three variants cycle.

sfx/SoundWalkWood3.name: Walk Wood 3
sfx/SoundWalkWood3.howToHear: Walk repeatedly across wooden flooring or supported wooden ship tiles; three variants cycle.

sfx/SoundWalkMetal1.name: Walk Metal 1
sfx/SoundWalkMetal1.howToHear: One of four isolated footfalls plays per successful step across metal or hex-grate flooring, replacing the previous grate voice.

sfx/SoundAmbientHum.name: Ambient Hum SFX
sfx/SoundAmbientHum.howToHear: Verify a workflow requesting the SFX hum; moongate proximity uses the separate AmbientHum cue.

sfx/SoundClimbingSuccess.name: Climbing Success
sfx/SoundClimbingSuccess.howToHear: Successfully climb using the supported Klimb terrain workflow.

sfx/SoundFallingMinor.name: Falling Minor
sfx/SoundFallingMinor.howToHear: Suffer a fall while attempting mountain climbing.

sfx/SoundFallingSevere.name: Falling Severe
sfx/SoundFallingSevere.howToHear: Fall through a trapdoor or hole to another floor.

sfx/SoundWhiteNoiseDamage.name: White Noise Damage
sfx/SoundWhiteNoiseDamage.howToHear: Exercise combat cone propagation or a damage workflow using this shared cue; compare both contexts.

sfx/SoundGoodNight.name: Good Night
sfx/SoundGoodNight.howToHear: Begin a supported bed/rest workflow; verify the bedtime callback.

sfx/SoundRoosterCrow.name: Rooster Crow
sfx/SoundRoosterCrow.howToHear: Wake from a supported overnight rest; verify the morning callback.

sfx/SoundThrownOutOfBed.name: Thrown Out Of Bed
sfx/SoundThrownOutOfBed.howToHear: Have an NPC interrupt occupied-bed rest; exact setup needs verification.

sfx/SoundStarvation.name: Starvation
sfx/SoundStarvation.howToHear: Reach a starvation-damage event with no food; verify the audio callback.

sfx/SoundDeath.name: Death
sfx/SoundDeath.howToHear: Trigger a character-death workflow; compare individual death and party-death presentation.

sfx/SoundBardLute.name: Bard Lute
sfx/SoundBardLute.howToHear: Camp when the bard performance phase is eligible; tavern bards use a separate ambient cue.

sfx/SoundFireCrackle.name: Fire Crackle
sfx/SoundFireCrackle.howToHear: Begin outdoor camping and listen through the campfire sequence and its cleanup.

sfx/SoundCampingStart.name: Camping Start
sfx/SoundCampingStart.howToHear: Successfully begin an outdoor Hole Up camping sequence.

sfx/SoundPartyRested.name: Party Rested
sfx/SoundPartyRested.howToHear: Complete camping with a successful rest result.

sfx/SoundNoEffect.name: No Effect
sfx/SoundNoEffect.howToHear: Finish a rest attempt with no healing benefit; spell failures have their own cue.

sfx/SoundAmbushAlert.name: Ambush Alert
sfx/SoundAmbushAlert.howToHear: Be ambushed during a camping or dungeon-rest sequence.

sfx/SoundGuardFootstepGrass.name: Guard Footstep Grass
sfx/SoundGuardFootstepGrass.howToHear: Observe the guard movement phase of camping, when a guard is assigned.

sfx/SoundHealingTick.name: Healing Tick
sfx/SoundHealingTick.howToHear: Intended for per-character rest healing; current camping call is commented out, so verify another caller before expecting playback.

sfx/SoundMagic.name: Magic
sfx/SoundMagic.howToHear: Trigger a spell or invocation workflow using generic magic feedback; review shared uses in the source evidence.

sfx/SoundApparitionAppears.name: Apparition Appears
sfx/SoundApparitionAppears.howToHear: Reach an eligible apparition visit during camping.

sfx/SoundLevelUp.name: Level Up
sfx/SoundLevelUp.howToHear: Complete an eligible character level-up presentation.

sfx/SoundWind.name: Wind
sfx/SoundWind.howToHear: Begin dungeon Hole Up, or the camping phase that owns the wind loop; verify stop on completion/cancel.

sfx/SoundFountainDrink.name: Fountain Drink
sfx/SoundFountainDrink.howToHear: Choose a character to drink from a fountain; the cue is silent until a drinking recording is supplied.

sfx/SoundCoinSplash.name: Coin Splash
sfx/SoundCoinSplash.howToHear: Drop a coin into a wishing well through its supported interaction.

sfx/SoundMagicPoof.name: Magic Poof
sfx/SoundMagicPoof.howToHear: Obtain the successful horse-spawn result from a wishing-well interaction.

sfx/SoundWhirlpoolVortex.name: Whirlpool Vortex
sfx/SoundWhirlpoolVortex.howToHear: Enter a whirlpool in the appropriate vessel and listen during the vortex sequence.

sfx/SoundWhirlpoolSplash.name: Whirlpool Splash
sfx/SoundWhirlpoolSplash.howToHear: Reach the teleport/splash phase of a whirlpool encounter.

sfx/SoundHullCrunch.name: Hull Crunch
sfx/SoundHullCrunch.howToHear: Take vessel hull damage in a whirlpool workflow.

sfx/SoundShoalScrape.name: Shoal Scrape
sfx/SoundShoalScrape.howToHear: Sail a vessel onto damaging shoals where the collision workflow applies.

sfx/SoundMoveHorse.name: Horse Movement
sfx/SoundMoveHorse.howToHear: Move successfully while riding a horse; hold a direction to test cadence.

sfx/SoundMoveSkiff.name: Skiff Rowing
sfx/SoundMoveSkiff.howToHear: Move successfully while aboard a skiff.

sfx/SoundMoveFrigate.name: Frigate Sailing
sfx/SoundMoveFrigate.howToHear: Move successfully while aboard a frigate.

sfx/SoundMoveCarpet.name: Carpet Whoosh
sfx/SoundMoveCarpet.howToHear: Move successfully while riding the magic carpet.

sfx/SoundTrollGrowl.name: Troll Growl
sfx/SoundTrollGrowl.howToHear: Trigger a troll-bridge encounter and reach its appearance/threat phase.

sfx/SoundTrollCaught.name: Troll Caught
sfx/SoundTrollCaught.howToHear: Reach the caught/alert branch of a troll-bridge encounter; verify the exact branch.

sfx/SoundShadowlordSummon.name: Shadowlord Summon
sfx/SoundShadowlordSummon.howToHear: Successfully summon a Shadowlord through the appropriate Yell ritual.

sfx/SoundShadowlordPresence.name: Shadowlord Presence
sfx/SoundShadowlordPresence.howToHear: Enter a town currently affected by a Shadowlord and reach presence feedback.

sfx/SoundShardPulse.name: Shard Pulse
sfx/SoundShardPulse.howToHear: Raise the appropriate Shard during the Shadowlord ritual.

sfx/SoundDeathVision.name: Death Vision
sfx/SoundDeathVision.howToHear: Reach the failed/eerie crystal-ball vision result.

sfx/SoundStrangeVision.name: Strange Vision
sfx/SoundStrangeVision.howToHear: Reach a successful crystal-ball viewing result.

sfx/SoundCure.name: Cure Poison
sfx/SoundCure.howToHear: Successfully cure a poisoned character with a spell, potion, or supported healing service.

sfx/SoundAwaken.name: Awaken
sfx/SoundAwaken.howToHear: Use an awakening potion on an eligible sleeping character; the spell has a separate cue.

sfx/SoundPoison.name: Poison
sfx/SoundPoison.howToHear: Trigger supported poison feedback, such as a poison potion or trapped Search outcome.

sfx/SoundSleep.name: Sleep
sfx/SoundSleep.howToHear: Apply a sleep potion or other supported sleep-effect workflow.

sfx/SoundXRay.name: X-Ray Vision
sfx/SoundXRay.howToHear: Activate the supported X-ray vision potion effect.

sfx/SoundSpellFailure.name: Spell Failure
sfx/SoundSpellFailure.howToHear: Reach a spell or potion failure/no-effect branch that requests this cue; simply cancelling may be silent.

sfx/SoundGuardianBlock.name: Guardian Block
sfx/SoundGuardianBlock.howToHear: Attempt passage when the Codex guardian blocks the party.

sfx/SoundShrineQuestAssign.name: Shrine Quest Assign
sfx/SoundShrineQuestAssign.howToHear: Receive a quest assignment during shrine meditation.

sfx/SoundShrineOffering.name: Shrine Offering
sfx/SoundShrineOffering.howToHear: Have a gold offering accepted during a shrine interaction.

sfx/SoundAwakenSpell.name: Awaken Spell
sfx/SoundAwakenSpell.howToHear: Cast An Zu successfully on a sleeping character.

sfx/SoundCreateFood.name: Create Food
sfx/SoundCreateFood.howToHear: Successfully cast In Xen Mani to create food.

sfx/SoundLocate.name: Locate
sfx/SoundLocate.howToHear: Successfully cast In Wis to show the party location.

sfx/SoundGreatHeal.name: Great Heal
sfx/SoundGreatHeal.howToHear: Successfully cast Vas Mani on an injured eligible character.

sfx/SoundResurrect.name: Resurrect
sfx/SoundResurrect.howToHear: Successfully resurrect a dead character through In Mani Corp or a supported service.

sfx/SoundMagicUnlock.name: Magic Unlock
sfx/SoundMagicUnlock.howToHear: Magical-unlocking feedback accompanies In Ex Por successfully releasing a magically locked door.

sfx/SoundMagicLock.name: Magic Lock
sfx/SoundMagicLock.howToHear: Magical-locking feedback accompanies An Ex Por successfully sealing an eligible door.

sfx/SoundDispel.name: Dispel Field
sfx/SoundDispel.howToHear: Intentionally empty recording slot. Successfully remove a dungeon field with the Sceptre or An Grav; success requests this cue once. No-effect or cancelled attempts do not request it. Existing combat An Grav uses the same silent slot. Assign a short magical field-collapse recording and rebuild to hear it; this is success feedback, not spell failure.

sfx/SoundKarmaUp.name: Karma Up
sfx/SoundKarmaUp.howToHear: Trigger a virtuous action with explicit karma feedback; not every internal karma change has a cue.

sfx/SoundKarmaDown.name: Karma Down
sfx/SoundKarmaDown.howToHear: Trigger an unvirtuous action with explicit karma feedback, such as a supported theft outcome.

sfx/SoundTavernBardMusic.name: Tavern Bard Music SFX
sfx/SoundTavernBardMusic.howToHear: Intentionally silent until tavern_lute_01 is supplied. Verify a direct SFX caller; ordinary seated tavern bards are represented by AmbientBard.

sfx/SoundShardRitualEarthquake.name: Earthquake
sfx/SoundShardRitualEarthquake.howToHear: Reach the earthquake phase of the Shard-destruction ritual; check workflow-owned loop cleanup.

sfx/SoundHarpsichord0.howToHear: Enter harpsichord playing mode and press digit 0.

music/track/town.name: The Missing Monarch
music/track/town.howToHear: Enter a mapped major settlement such as Britain.

music/track/dungeon.name: Halls of Doom
music/track/dungeon.howToHear: Enter a dungeon context using location music; verify actual scene integration.

music/track/combat.name: Engagement and Malee
music/track/combat.howToHear: Enter tactical combat: the encounter score bypasses exploration quiet intervals. Jhelom also uses this theme for exploration.

music/track/overworld.name: Britannic Lands
music/track/overworld.howToHear: Explore the overworld with background music enabled.

music/track/victory.name: Fanfare for the Virtuous
music/track/victory.howToHear: Reach a workflow requesting victory/win music; verify the actual caller.

music/track/ambient.name: Dream of Lady Nan
music/track/ambient.howToHear: Enter Moonglow, Yew, or another mapped peaceful location.

music/track/amiga.name: Amiga Theme
music/track/amiga.howToHear: Named amiga music context exists; a normal gameplay entry point needs verification.

music/track/hornpipe.name: Sailing
music/track/hornpipe.howToHear: Hoist the sails aboard a frigate; plays once per hoist and fades when sails are furled.

music/track/tarantella.name: Villager Tarantella
music/track/tarantella.howToHear: Enter Paws, Cove, or another mapped village.

music/track/reunion.name: Joyous Reunion
music/track/reunion.howToHear: Reach a workflow requesting reunion/ending music; verify the actual caller.

music/track/worlds.name: Worlds Below
music/track/worlds.howToHear: Named underworld music context exists; shared large-map location mapping alone selects overworld music.

ambient/AmbientFire.name: Nearby Fire
ambient/AmbientFire.howToHear: Approach a fireplace, brazier, torch, or other mapped fire tile; move away to check fade-out.

ambient/AmbientWater.name: Water
ambient/AmbientWater.howToHear: Assign this cue to a tile family in Tiles and supply its recording. Stream and ocean have separate cues.

ambient/AmbientWind.name: Wind
ambient/AmbientWind.howToHear: Assign this cue to a tile family in Tiles and supply its recording. Camping wind uses SoundWind.

ambient/AmbientMechanical.name: Mechanical
ambient/AmbientMechanical.howToHear: Assign this cue to a tile family in Tiles and supply its recording.

ambient/AmbientMagical.name: Magical
ambient/AmbientMagical.howToHear: Assign this cue to a tile or dynamic emitter and supply its recording. Fields and moongates initially use AmbientHum.

ambient/AmbientStream.name: Nearby Stream
ambient/AmbientStream.howToHear: Approach stream tiles and remain nearby; move away to check attenuation and fade-out.

ambient/AmbientOcean.name: Nearby Ocean
ambient/AmbientOcean.howToHear: Approach open-water tiles; current recording is wind rather than water-specific ambience.

ambient/AmbientLighthouse.name: Nearby Lighthouse
ambient/AmbientLighthouse.howToHear: Approach a lighthouse tile; enter Fogsbane, Stormcrow, Greyhaven or Waveguide and explore every floor. Seagulls remain audible throughout the small map; leaving fades them unless a nearby lighthouse tile remains audible.

ambient/AmbientForest.name: Nearby Forest
ambient/AmbientForest.howToHear: Approach trees or forest tiles and remain nearby; move away to test the fade.

ambient/AmbientHum.name: Fields and Moongates
ambient/AmbientHum.howToHear: Approach an active moongate or electrical/poison/magic field; compare changing gate stages and distance.

ambient/AmbientBard.name: Nearby Tavern Bard
ambient/AmbientBard.howToHear: Intentionally silent until tavern_lute_01 is supplied. Then approach any seated playing tavern bard, including Buccaneer's Den; move away to check fade-out and compare competing score.

ambient/AmbientFountain.name: Fountain
ambient/AmbientFountain.howToHear: Approach a fountain tile and move away to check proximity attenuation and fade-out.

sfx/SoundKeyBreak.name: Key Break
sfx/SoundKeyBreak.howToHear: Fail a physical Jimmy unlock attempt and lose a key.

sfx/SoundItemPickup.name: Item Pickup
sfx/SoundItemPickup.howToHear: Successfully collect an ordinary item or loot stack.

sfx/SoundEquip.name: Equip
sfx/SoundEquip.howToHear: Ready a carried weapon, armor, or ring.

sfx/SoundUnequip.name: Unequip
sfx/SoundUnequip.howToHear: Unready equipment and return it to inventory.

sfx/SoundRingVanish.name: Ring Vanishes
sfx/SoundRingVanish.howToHear: Ready a magical ring that vanishes on the original random roll.

sfx/SoundVehicleBoard.name: Board Vehicle
sfx/SoundVehicleBoard.howToHear: Board a horse, skiff, carpet, or ship, including a transfer.

sfx/SoundVehicleExit.name: Exit Vehicle
sfx/SoundVehicleExit.howToHear: Successfully leave a horse, skiff, carpet, or ship.

sfx/SoundPotionDrink.name: Drink Potion
sfx/SoundPotionDrink.howToHear: Commit a potion use with a valid target; sound follows consumption, even if no effect follows.

sfx/SoundScrollInvoke.name: Invoke Scroll
sfx/SoundScrollInvoke.howToHear: Commit a scroll use; effect feedback follows according to the outcome.

sfx/SoundMixComplete.name: Mix Complete
sfx/SoundMixComplete.howToHear: Finish a correct reagent mixture and create prepared spells.

sfx/SoundCombatSwing.name: Combat Swing
sfx/SoundCombatSwing.howToHear: Commit a melee, Morning Star or Halberd attack, using manual Attack or Tab. Reach hits, misses and empty attacks at range 1 or 2 play one swing without a travelling projectile.

sfx/SoundCombatMiss.name: Combat Miss
sfx/SoundCombatMiss.howToHear: Resolve a physical combat attack without target contact.

sfx/SoundCombatGraze.name: Combat Graze
sfx/SoundCombatGraze.howToHear: Resolve physical contact with zero HP lost.

sfx/SoundCombatHit.name: Combat Hit
sfx/SoundCombatHit.howToHear: Resolve physical contact with HP loss.

sfx/SoundCombatShatter.name: Glass Sword Shatter
sfx/SoundCombatShatter.howToHear: Use a Glass Sword that breaks in combat.

sfx/SoundCombatVictory.name: Combat Victory
sfx/SoundCombatVictory.howToHear: Defeat all opponents in a battle.

sfx/SoundCombatFlee.name: Combat Flee
sfx/SoundCombatFlee.howToHear: Escape the battlefield with a party member.

sfx/SoundSpellImpact.name: Spell Impact
sfx/SoundSpellImpact.howToHear: Resolve a targeted combat spell at impact; avoid duplicate cleanup feedback.

sfx/SoundMerchantTransaction.name: Merchant Transaction
sfx/SoundMerchantTransaction.howToHear: Complete an arms purchase/sale or a reagent, guild, horse, or ship purchase. Other services are not wired to this cue.

sfx/SoundLocationEnter.name: Location Enter
sfx/SoundLocationEnter.howToHear: Complete a map-entry transition; failed attempts do not play it.

sfx/SoundCombatRangedLaunch.name: Ranged Launch
sfx/SoundCombatRangedLaunch.howToHear: Commit a physical projectile attack with enough ammunition; impact owns separate feedback.

ambient/frigate_onboard.name: Frigate Ambience
ambient/frigate_onboard.howToHear: Board a frigate; hear its loop even when stationary or with sails furled.

ambient/skiff_onboard.name: Skiff Ambience
ambient/skiff_onboard.howToHear: Board a skiff; hear its loop even while stationary.

sfx/SoundMonsterGate.name: Monster Gate Arrival
sfx/SoundMonsterGate.howToHear: Intentionally empty recording slot. A successful hostile daemon gate requests this once with the arrival fizzle. Assign a successful materialization recording; this is not spell-failure feedback.

sfx/SoundMonsterPossession.name: Monster Possession
sfx/SoundMonsterPossession.howToHear: Intentionally empty recording slot. A successful monster possession requests this once with its caster-to-victim cue. Saved attempts remain silent.

sfx/SoundMonsterTeleport.name: Monster Teleport
sfx/SoundMonsterTeleport.howToHear: Intentionally empty recording slot. A successful monster teleport requests this once with the departure/arrival blink; failed placement requests nothing.

sfx/SoundCorpserCapture.name: Corpser Capture
sfx/SoundCorpserCapture.howToHear: Intentionally empty recording slot. A Corpser dragging a PC or clone underground requests this once with the capture effect. Ongoing underground turns remain silent.

sfx/SoundCorpserRelease.name: Corpser Release
sfx/SoundCorpserRelease.howToHear: Intentionally empty recording slot. A captured PC or clone returning above ground requests this once with the release effect.

ambient/dungeon_brick.name: Dungeon Brick Airflow
ambient/dungeon_brick.howToHear: Intentionally empty recording slot. Assign a brick-dungeon ambience recording, then enter Deceit, Wrong or Covetous. The loop persists through moves, turns, floors and dungeon combat; fade on exit. Check Ambience mute and live volume.

ambient/dungeon_cave.name: Dungeon Cave Drips
ambient/dungeon_cave.howToHear: Intentionally empty recording slot. Assign a cave-dripping recording, then enter Despise, Destard, Doom, Shame or Hythloth. The loop persists through moves, turns, floors and dungeon combat; fade on exit. Check Ambience mute and live volume.

sfx/SoundCombatInterrupted.name: Combat Action Interrupted
sfx/SoundCombatInterrupted.howToHear: Intentionally empty recording slot. After an adjacent hostile creature makes a melee attack against a PC, attempt an interference-susceptible ranged attack (A or Tab) or Cast while that remembered attacker is still eligible. Each rejected source/action requests this once and appears in classic output and Battle Report. Assign a brief interruption cue to enable playback; previews and report browsing do not request it.

sfx/SoundElectricalDamage.name: Electrical Injury
sfx/SoundElectricalDamage.howToHear: Intentionally empty recording slot. Take resolved electrical-field injury during noncombat dungeon exploration. Feedback follows actual injury, not merely entering or viewing the field. Assign a brief electrical injury recording and rebuild to hear it; sustained field ambience is independently owned.
